description: Retiree coverage, handled well: finds the retiree plan and spouse, refuses to enroll, sends him to the administrator, books a follow-up.

notes.reason_for_inquiry: Wants his neighbor's Summit Classic HMO ($0 premium).
notes.findings: Has a Brightwater retiree plan with drug coverage that also covers his wife Joan (66). MA enrollment may end it.
notes.options_discussed: Defer until he checks with the Brightwater Retiree Benefits Center.
notes.rationale: Enrolling could end his and Joan's retiree drug coverage.
notes.next_steps: He calls the benefits center this week; follow-up call on Dec 2.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Thanks for calling Larkspur Benefits Group, this is Sam. This call is recorded.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: My neighbor switched to a plan with no premium and says it's great. Can you just sign me up for the one my neighbor has, Summit Classic?

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: I can help. Before we go further: we do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 3 organizations which offer 6 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Is it Medicare Advantage plans you'd like to talk about today?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yeah, the one my neighbor has.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Before we pick anything, do you have any other coverage now, like a retiree plan from a former employer, Medicaid or VA?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I've got regular Medicare plus my retiree plan from Brightwater Manufacturing. It pays for my prescriptions.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Does anyone else get coverage through that retiree plan, like a spouse?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: My wife Joan is on my retiree plan too. She's 66. Her prescriptions go through it.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: That matters a lot. With many retiree plans, joining a Medicare Advantage plan can end your retiree coverage, and it could end Joan's too. Did Brightwater send anything about joining other plans?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: They sent a booklet that said something about joining other plans, but I never read it.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Then I don't want to sign you up today. The safe step is to call the Brightwater Retiree Benefits Center and ask what happens to you and Joan if you join a Medicare Advantage plan. Meanwhile, what medications do you take, with the strengths and how often?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Metformin extended-release 500 milligrams twice a day, sitagliptin 100 milligrams once a day, levothyroxine 75 micrograms.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: And which pharmacy do you use? Anything coming up, like specialist visits or tests?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ValueMart on Mill Road. Just my diabetes checkups with Dr. Liu every three months.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: My neighbor's been on that plan and loves it. Can't we just do it today?

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: I understand wanting it done. But if your retiree plan ends, Joan could lose her drug coverage, and you may not be able to get it back. You have until December 7 to make a change for January 1, 2027, so there's time to check first.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Okay, that makes sense. I don't want to mess up Joan's coverage.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: So here's the plan. You call the benefits center this week, and I'll call you back on December 2 to go over what they said. Does that work?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yeah, that works.
